L654 '학습 엔진은 앞서 설명한 PP·EP·ZeRO-1 조합으로 파라미터를 나눕니다' is not stated for the RL training engine.
L838 groups 'Criminal·Privacy·Security의 프롬프트 인젝션과 반복 탈옥' as weak spots, but on Criminal-Iterative Jailbreak K2 is the best model (57.57 vs 21.21/25.76/53.03).
No fabricated numbers found: every checked table cell and in-text number matched the source.
